verdict.rationale: Undermind explicitly offers alert-style notification ('Get notified whenever relevant papers are published') and paper starring/curation for ongoing monitoring, directly matching the standing-search/alert use case. However, evidence is a single first-party mention with no detail on alert configuration, frequency, delivery channel, or independent user corroboration of this specific feature. Missing for 10: detailed docs on alert setup/customization, independent/community confirmation the alerting feature works as described, and info on how alerts integrate with saved searches vs. folders.
